changelog: **Self-served company API keys (#2006, 1/n):** a COMPANY owner mints, lists and revokes API keys for their own data at `/api/company/integrations/api-keys`. The key is bound to the company (`ApiKey.companyId`, additive), always expires, and never holds more than `COMPANY_KEY_SCOPE_CEILING` (`hiring:read`) — a request above it is `403 scope_above_ceiling`, not a narrowed grant. `withApiKey()` gains a fail-closed `{ companyScoped: true }` opt-in: a company key is admitted only on routes that narrow every read to its company (`companyOnly(key)`: requisitions, offers, interview requests, `/me`), and answers `403 company_key_not_allowed` everywhere else, exports included. The admin key list shows each key's company; mint and revoke are audited at warning level; the route is in the demo blocklist.

en: Companies can now create their own API keys for their requisitions, offers and interview requests — no admin needed, always time-limited, and never reaching beyond the company's own records.
tr: Şirketler artık iş talepleri, teklifleri ve mülakat talepleri için kendi API anahtarlarını oluşturabiliyor — admin gerekmeden, her zaman süreli ve asla şirketin kendi kayıtlarının dışına çıkmadan.
de: Unternehmen können jetzt eigene API-Schlüssel für ihre Stellen, Angebote und Interviewanfragen erstellen — ohne Admin, immer befristet und nie über die eigenen Datensätze hinaus.
